test_challenge_evaluation_pipeline: test the CO3D challenge evaluation pipeline by running unittest on test_challenge_evaluate.py
evaluate_file_folders: evaluate prediction and ground truth folders and return average and per-example metrics
eval_one: evaluate a single RGBDA prediction against a ground truth target and return iou, psnr, and depth metrics
store_rgbda_frame: store an RGBDAFrame with image, mask, and depth data to a directory as PNG files
load_rgbda_frame: load an RGBDAFrame from a directory by reading image, mask, and depth PNG files
